direction: Bright, playful, theatrical, affectionate; an original Erva performance, not a voice clone.

lines.greeting_1: Ah, there you are! I was hoping you'd stop by.
lines.greeting_2: Welcome back, my dear adventurer. Shall we begin?
lines.encourage_1: Chin up! Every grand adventure begins with a little courage.
lines.encourage_2: Oh, take your time. Even heroes deserve a little rest.
lines.gift_1: A little surprise, just for you! Go on. You've earned it.
lines.gift_2: Well, look at you! Here. A little something for our rising star.
lines.rank_1: Bravo! A brand new rank. Oh, I'm so proud of you!
lines.rank_2: And there it is! Your moment to shine. Shall we celebrate?
